name: tipster-aggregator-backend
description: Cloud backend for the Tipster Aggregator app: follows public Telegram tipster channels via the t.me/s preview, parses picks against key-less ESPN fixtures/odds, settles against real results, and scores each channel by ROI with CLV as the headline metric. Structured after lumeierecollection-blip/tradeapp's signal_aggregator/server: in-memory cache, self-scheduled scan loop, JSON-file persistence, one dependency.
